author: granite state times
title: American Red Cross and Nashua to hold community blood drive June 23
text:
The City of Nashua announced on May 27 that it will host a community blood drive in partnership with the American Red Cross and the Nashua Employee Wellness Program. The event is scheduled for Tuesday, June 23, from 9:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
The blood drive will take place at Nashua City Hall in the auditorium on the third floor, located at 229 Main Street in Nashua, New Hampshire. Organizers say the collaboration aims to encourage local residents and city employees to donate blood and support ongoing healthcare needs.
According to event details, all eligible donors are welcome during the scheduled hours. The effort reflects continued cooperation between municipal wellness initiatives and national organizations like the American Red Cross.
Blood drives such as this one help address regional shortages and provide critical resources for hospitals and patients requiring transfusions.
Further information about registration or specific requirements was not provided in the announcement.
